## Changes

- Reject command approval requests with missing or unsupported choices instead of offering a different approval.
- Keep pinned threads separate from custom sections also named Pinned.
- Keep attachment and archived-thread paths valid when names contain malformed Unicode or exceed the segment limit.
- Remove HTTP status codes from Codex error notices while retaining the error and retry guidance.
- Update compatibility for Codex CLI 0.158.0.
